Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

money — coins and notes used to buy things. Example: I have got some money.
price — how much something costs. Example: The price is ten euros.
cost — to have a price. Example: It costs five euros.
euro — the money of many European countries. Example: It costs ten euros.
dollar — the money of the USA. Example: They cost ten dollars.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• How much is it?
• It costs ...
• They cost ...
• In euros or dollars?
• The price is ...
